8222.title: HTTP content encoding is ignored by tunnel compression
8222.rootCauseOneLine: TunnelSession forwards already-encoded HTTP bodies through an unconditional ws send that defaults to deflate when negotiated.

prReviews.verdict: STATICALLY ALIGNED — existing open fix; branch not executed
prReviews.topFinding: Selective body compression addresses the verified root cause; test uses a synthetic encoding header rather than real brotli bytes.

8222.proposedFix: Skip WebSocket compression for already-encoded HTTP body frames while preserving it for unencoded bodies and realtime data; existing PR #8223 is open.
8222.caveats: Conditional local transport bug reproduced twice. Production Cloudflare negotiation and the reported CPU and wire-size benchmarks were not measured. Test and output are inline per public reports policy.
